title: Demo Clinic A (fictional general-care clinic)
prompt: Build a polished, accessible clinic website for Demo Clinic A, a fictional general-care clinic in Sample City. It offers general consultations, preventive-care visits and chronic-condition follow-up. The fictional clinician is Dr. Demo A, MBBS. Hours, phone, street address, booking endpoint, public domain and reviews are unknown: use graceful contact placeholders and navigation, without fabricating these details. Use two pages: Home and Contact. Adapt the layout of https://ravenhealth.com/ recognizably: match content width, desktop/mobile hero proportions, type scale, section spacing and surface rhythm, using original clinic copy and original assets. Do not copy source text, identities, logos or images. Include useful clinic/service copy, working navigation and an accessible mobile menu. Do not add a nonfunctional appointment form. Deliver runnable HTML/CSS/local JS. Avoid external analytics, authentication and databases.
